questions.stem:
The density of 'x' M solution ('x' molar) of NaOH is $1.12\ \mathrm{g\,mL^{-1}}$. while in molality, the concentration of the solution is 3 m (3 molal). Then x is
(Given : Molar mass of NaOH is 40 g/mol)
questions.solution:
Molality $= \frac{1000 \times M}{1000 \times d - M \times (M_w)_{solute}}$
$3 = \frac{1000 \times x}{1000 \times 1.12 - (x \times 40)}$
$x = 3$

questions.stem:
At $-20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ and 1 atm pressure, a cylinder is filled with equal number of $\mathrm{H_2}$. $\mathrm{I_2}$ and HI molecules for the reaction
$\mathrm{H_2(g) + I_2(g) \rightleftharpoons 2HI(g)}$, the $K_P$ for the process is $x \times 10^{-1}$. $x$ = _________.
[Given : $R = 0.082\ \mathrm{L\,atm\,K^{-1}\,mol^{-1}}$]
questions.solution:
$\Delta n_g = 0$
$K_p = \frac{(n_{HI})^{2}}{n_{H_2} n_{I_2}} \left(\frac{P_T}{n_T}\right)^{\Delta n_g}$
$n_{HI} = n_{H_2} = n_{I_2}$ so $K_P = 1$
$1 = x \times 10^{-1}$
$x = 10$

questions.stem: 9.3 g of pure aniline upon diazotisation followed by coupling with phenol gives an orange dye. The mass of orange dye produced (assume 100% yield/ conversion) is ________g. (nearest integer)
questions.solution:
Reaction suggests that 1 mole of aniline give 1 mole of orange dye.
so $(\mathrm{mol})_{aniline} = (\mathrm{mole})_{orange\ dye}$
$\frac{9.3\ \mathrm{g}}{93\ \mathrm{g\,mol^{-1}}} = \frac{\text{mass of orange dye}}{199\ \mathrm{g\,mol^{-1}}}$
mass of orange dye $= 19.9\ \mathrm{g} \approx 20\ \mathrm{g}$

Among $\mathrm{CrO}$, $\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}$ and $\mathrm{CrO_3}$, the sum of spin-only magnetic moment values of basic and amphoteric oxides is ______ $10^{-2}$ BM (nearest integer).
(Given atomic number of Cr is 24)
questions.solution:
CrO Basic oxide
$\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}$ Amphoteric oxide
In CrO, Cr exist as $\mathrm{Cr^{+2}}$ and have $\mu_{only} = 4.90$
In $\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}$, Cr exist as $\mathrm{Cr^{+3}}$ and have $\mu_{only} = 3.87$
Sum of spin only magnetic moment $= 4.90 + 3.87 = 8.77$
$\mu_{only} = 877 \times 10^{-2}$

questions.stem:
An ideal gas, $\overline{C}_V = \frac{5}{2}R$, is expanded adiabatically against a constant pressure of 1 atm untill it doubles in volume. If the initial temperature and pressure is 298 K and 5 atm, respectively then the final temperature is ______ K (nearest integer).
[$\overline{C}_V$ is the molar heat capacity at constant volume]
questions.solution:
$\Delta U = q + w$ ($q = 0$)
$nC_V \Delta T = -P_{ext}(V_2 - V_1)$
$V_2 = 2V_1$
$\frac{nRT_2}{P_2} = \frac{2nRT_1}{P_1}$
$P_1 = 5$, $T_1 = 298$
$P_2 = \frac{5T_2}{2 \times 298}$
$n\frac{5}{2}R(T_2 - T_1) = -1\left(\frac{nRT_2}{P_1} - \frac{nRT_1}{P_1}\right)$
Put $T_1 = 298$
and $P_2 = \frac{5T_2}{2 \times 298}$
Solve and we get $T_2 = 274.16\ \mathrm{K}$
$T_2 \approx 274\ \mathrm{K}$
